details: ➔ Client : Open Bank – Spain
Domain  : Banking
The goal of the project at Openbank Spain was to implement and streamline cheque guarantee

functionality  within the T24 Core Banking  system, ensuring  secure  handling  of high-value and sensi- tive cheque transactions. The initiative  aimed to provide customers with certified cheques backed
by the bank, thereby increasing trust and reliability in payments such as property down payments

or large financial commitments. The project focused on enabling guarantee initiation, cancella - tions, stop payments,  and handling  of non-presented  cheques  during  the validity  period,  with funds

pliant, and efficient digital banking operations.
• Led Agile delivery of cheque guarantee functionality within the T24 Core Banking system,
enabling  secure  initiation,  cancellation,  stop payments,  and non-payment  handling  of certi- fied cheques.
• Facilitated  Agile ceremonies  (daily stand -ups, sprint planning,  retrospectives)  to ensure it- erative progress across design, development, testing, and deployment phases.
• Collaborated  with cross-functional  squads (Core Banking,  Payments,  Compliance,  Risk, and
Operations)  to prioritize  backlog  items and deliver incremental  enhancements  aligned with
Openbank Spain’s regulatory and customer requirements.
• Managed  sprint-based integration  activities,  ensuring  seamless  handling  of suspense  ac- counts, guarantee validity periods, and customer account reconciliation.
• Partnered with vendors and internal stakeholders to validate solution design, conduct
proof-of-concept  trials, and optimize  system  performance  for high-value cheque  transac - tions.
• Developed training and enablement materials  for operations  and customer  service  teams,
ensuring  adoption  of new cheque  guarantee  processes  and compliance  with banking  stand- ards.
• Applied Agile metrics  (velocity,  burndown  charts,  defect tracking)  to monitor progress,
identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues during rollout.
• Delivered  measurable  outcomes,  strengthening  transaction  security,  improving  customer
trust in certified  cheques,  and aligning  with Openbank  Spain’s commitment  to robust and
efficient digital banking operations.
➔ Client : Open Bank – Spain
Domain  : Banking
Role : Project  Manager

The goal of the project  was to enhance  Openbank  Spain’s T24 Core Banking system  to ensure com- pliance with Spanish  Tax Authority  regulations  governing  joint accounts  and deposits.  Specifically,
the system needed to validate that all beneficial owners of a joint account or deposit share the
same residential status —either all residents of Spain or all non -residents. The initiative aimed to prevent the creation of joint accounts with mixed residency status, enforce accurate validations
during account opening, and provide clear error messaging when rules were violated. By imple - menting these controls, the project sought to strengthen regulatory compliance, improve opera -
tional accuracy,  and safeguard  customer  trust in Openbank  Spain’s account  management  processes.
• Led Agile delivery  of compliance  enhancements  in the T24 Core Banking system to enforce
Spanish Tax Authority rules on joint accounts and deposits.
• Facilitated  Agile ceremonies  (daily stand-ups, sprint planning,  retrospectives)  to drive iter- ative progress across requirement validation, system design, development, and testing.
• Collaborated  with cross-functional  squads (Core Banking,  Compliance,  Risk, IT, and Opera- tions) to prioritize backlog items and ensure regulatory alignment.
• Defined  user stories  and acceptance  criteria for residency  validation,  ensuring  the system
correctly restricted joint accounts to either all residents or all non -residents.
• Managed  sprint-based system  integration  and testing activities,  validating  error messages
and exception handling for mixed residency scenarios.
• Partnered  with stakeholders  and vendors  to ensure  solution  design adhered  to compliance
standards and operational workflows.
• Developed  training  and enablement  materials  for branch and operations  staff to ensure
smooth adoption of new account validation processes.
• Applied Agile metrics  (velocity,  burndown  charts,  defect tracking)  to monitor delivery  pro- gress, identify risks, and proactively mitigate issues.
• Delivered measurable outcomes, strengthening regulatory compliance, improving opera - tional accuracy,  and safeguarding  customer  trust in Openbank  Spain’s account  management
processes.

The goal of the project was to implement and strengthen Deposit Interest Retention Tax (DIRT)

projects.name: @ TECH MAHINDRA August 2016 – August 2017
details: ➔ Client : CHEVRON , USA
The goal of the project was to transform Chevron Lubricants’ global Service Center operations
by standardizing on Salesforce Service Cloud and leveraging its matured functionalities and
industry  best practices.  This initiative  supported  the launch  of Chevron  Business  Point 2.0 (CBP),
an e-commerce platform designed to enhance customer engagement through new digital
channels.  The project aimed to modernize  customer  service  processes,  improve  responsiveness,
and enable seamless integration with CBP 2.0, starting with pilot rollouts at LBST and Lubetek
before expanding to other Chevron businesses, including Marine and Europe. By doing so, Chevron
sought to maximize its investment in Salesforce Service  Cloud, strengthen customer
relationships, and drive operational excellence across its global service network.
• Directed end -to-end project delivery using the Waterfall methodology, overseeing
requirements  gathering,  design,  development,  testing, and global rollout of Salesforce
Service Cloud enhancements.
• Defined detailed project scope, timelines, and milestones, ensuring alignment with
Chevron’s  strategic  objective  of transforming  Service  Center operations  and supporting  CBP
2.0 launch.
• Coordinated  with business  stakeholders  across LBST, Lubetek,  Marine,  and European
divisions  to capture  requirements  and establish  standardized  processes  for customer
engagement.
• Managed  vendor  and internal  IT teams to configure  and implement  matured  Salesforce
Service Cloud functionalities, ensuring adherence to industry best practices.
• Oversaw  pilot implementations  at LBST and Lubetek,  validating  functionality,  gathering
feedback, and preparing for phased expansion to other Chevron businesses.
• Developed  comprehensive  documentation  including  functional  specifications,  test plans,
operational manuals, and training materials to support global adoption.
• Monitored  project  progress  against  baseline  schedules,  budgets,  and quality  standards,
escalating risks and implementing corrective actions where necessary.
• Ensured compliance  with Chevron’s  governance  frameworks,  change management
protocols, and global operational standards.
• Delivered measurable outcomes, enabling standardized customer service processes,
improved  responsiveness,  and maximized  ROI from Salesforce  Service Cloud investment.

details: ➔ Client  : AT&T (USA)
Domain : Telecom

network  capacity,  enable software -defined networking  (SDN) capabilities,  and enhance  overall reli- ability for both consumer and enterprise services. This initiative aimed to deliver a more scalable,

resilient, and future -ready infrastructure by deploying next -generation routers and switches, exe - cuting seamless live traffic migrations, and integrating vendor solutions in compliance with archi -
tectural  standards.  The program  was designed  to improve  customer  experience  through 40% latency
reduction and 70% capacity increase, while achieving cost efficiency by delivering the project un - der budget.

curement, deployment, and cutover.
• Managed cross -functional teams (Network Engineering, Planning, Operations, Security) to deliver phased upgrades  of core routers  and switches,  ensuring  compliance  with AT&T’s ar-
chitectural and reliability standards.
• Developed  detailed  project schedules,  milestone  plans, and dependency  tracking  to drive
execution and ensure timely delivery across all phases.
• Executed  structured  migration  plans for live customer  traffic,  coordinating  cutovers  with
zero unplanned service outages.
• Oversaw  vendor  contracts  and deliverables,  ensuring  seamless  technology  integration  and
adherence to compliance and security requirements.
• Controlled  a $10M+ capital budget,  delivering  the program  5% under budget while achieving
technical KPIs (40% latency reduction, 70% capacity increase).

efficient digital banking operations.
